title: Dispatch: ownership gate, structural name resolution, curated residue (attempt 1)
description:
Implements parent eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.5 (read it). Design decisions below are FINAL. Work ONLY in worktree .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.5.1 (branch eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.5.1). Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md and AGENTS.md "Permanent Test Evidence". Paths relative to packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/ unless stated.

## Live evidence (origin/main 6684c064, committed source-coverage.json)
- 179 entries resolve `ambiguous-normalized-name` (73 grouped in diagnostics.unresolvedOwnership). They count toward "accounted" today (summary.unaccounted=0) — the defect.
- 6 `unique-normalized-name` matches bind a heading to a record whose provenance.locator does NOT cite the heading's page (same defect class as the Class Features collapse fixed in #576): "Spell Slots" p12 Bard, p36 Ranger, p43 Sorcerer, p47 Warlock -> rule:spell-slots (p100); "Suggested Characteristics" p61 -> rule:suggested-characteristics (p60); "Size Categories" table-caption p92 -> table:size-categories (p254).
Supervisor simulation over the committed artifacts (reproduce it; treat it as a prediction, not acceptance):
- class-chapter scope (section in CLASS_CHAPTER_SECTIONS, exactly one candidate `feature:<class-lower>:*`): 38
- page locality (exactly one candidate whose provenance.locator cites the item page): 59
- structure filter (table-caption -> only `table:*` candidates; heading -> drop `table:*` candidates) then page locality: resolves the magic-item heading vs table pairs (p209-239), the Equipment table captions p72-74, and p76 "Ability Scores and Modifiers" (heading -> rule:, caption -> table:)
- residue needing curated rules: listed under F3.

## F1 fail-closed gate (sourceInventoryCoverage.ts assertSourceCoverage, or a sibling assert called beside it in index.ts)
With `requireComplete` (the real CLI import, `assertDeclarationsAreLive`) the import FAILS, listing every offender, when:
 (a) any entry's final resolution is `ambiguous-normalized-name`; and
 (b) any entry resolved `unique-normalized-name` or by the new structural resolution (F2) names an owner record whose provenance.locator does not cite the entry's page. The fix for (b) is a curated rule (correct owner) — never a locator change.
Fixture pipelines (requireComplete false) keep today's behaviour. The error text must say an ambiguous/non-local owner is fixed with a source-structural or curated owner rule, never by widening a locator. Coverage summary keeps `ambiguous` as its own count (never folded into record/childOf); on the real pack it must be 0.
Needs record locators at coverage time: extend CoverageRecordRef with optional `provenance?: { locator?: string }` (the RulesRecords passed in already carry it) and reuse `citedPages` from recordSourceAnchors.ts.

## F2 structural resolution (sourceInventoryCoverage.ts name auto-match, ~L440-470 where `ambiguous-normalized-name` is produced)
When the normalized name has >1 candidate, apply in order and stop at the first step that leaves exactly one candidate:
 1. structure filter: `table-caption` items keep only `table:*` candidates; `heading` items drop `table:*` candidates.
 2. class-chapter scope: item.section in CLASS_CHAPTER_SECTIONS -> keep candidates starting `feature:<section-lower>:`.
 3. page locality: keep candidates whose provenance.locator cites item.page.
A single survivor becomes status `record:<key>` with a NEW resolution kind `structural-normalized-name` { normalizedName, ownerKey, step: 'structure' | 'class-chapter' | 'page-locality', candidateKeys }. Otherwise it stays ambiguous (and F1 fails the real import). Apply the filters cumulatively (1 then 2 then 3 on the survivors) — deterministic and documented in a header comment. Add the new kind everywhere resolution kinds are switched over (assertSourceCoverage, diagnostics, formatters, the ledger) and to docs of CoverageResolution. Curated rules still outrank everything (eshyra-erf5.1 ordering unchanged).

## F3 curated residue (sourceInventoryCoverage.ts SRD_5_1_COVERAGE_RULES; generate from existing sets, no hand page lists where a set exists)
Verify each against `pdftotext -layout packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf` before adding:
 - Class chapters, headings "Hit Points", "Proficiencies", "Equipment" (36) -> childOfRule(`class:<lower>`), from CLASS_CHAPTER_SECTIONS. These are the class record's own hitDie/proficiency/startingEquipment fields.
 - "Spellcasting Ability" and "Spell Slots" in class chapters -> add both to SPELLCASTING_BOILERPLATE (owner via SPELLCASTING_BOILERPLATE_OWNER). Confirm assertSpellcastingSections (spellcastingSections.ts) still passes — those printed subheadings are already data.sections entries per eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.4; if not, stop and report.
 - p32 Paladin "Channel Divinity" (subheading inside Sacred Oath) -> childOfRule('feature:paladin:sacred-oath'). Verify the Sacred Oath record's data contains that text.
 - p62 "Equipment" chapter heading: if an emitted Equipment chapter-intro rule record exists, recordRule to it; otherwise the existing document-structure treatment used for other chapter headings. Report which.
 - p82 two "Spellcasting Ability" headings (Intelligence then Wisdom subsections): map by their printed parent ability heading -> rule:intelligence-spellcasting-ability / rule:wisdom-spellcasting-ability. Predicate on page + the preceding ability heading (derive from the inventory order; no bare line numbers unless nothing else distinguishes them — then document why).
 - p93-94 "Actions in Combat" headings Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, Use an Object -> recordRule(`action:<slug>`). The pack ALSO emits duplicate `rule:<slug>` records with the same text; do NOT delete them here — file a follow-up bead "Duplicate rule:* records for the ten combat actions" (P2, labels importer,srd,thaw) naming all ten keys and the evidence.
 - p61 "Suggested Characteristics" -> verify source; expected childOfRule('background:acolyte') (Acolyte's own section). Report.
 - p92 "Size Categories" table caption: the combat chapter reprints the Size Categories table also printed at p254. Compare the two printings' rows. If identical: recordRule('table:size-categories') for p92 AND make the table record's provenance cite both printed pages (source-derived page union from the parser, not a hand list). If different: stop and report.
 Anything else still ambiguous or non-local after F2+F3 = stop and report the exact items; do not invent owners.

## Tests (permanent evidence; AGENTS.md "Permanent Test Evidence")
- Unit: F2 resolver steps (structure, class-chapter, page-locality, cumulative, no-survivor stays ambiguous); F1 gate throws listing every ambiguous and every non-local owner, passes when clean, inert when requireComplete is false.
- Committed-artifact (srdSourceInventoryArtifact.test.ts): assert ownership MEMBERSHIP, not counts: every class chapter's Hit Points/Proficiencies/Equipment is child-of its class; every class Spell Slots / Spellcasting Ability is child-of its spellcasting/pact-magic feature; the ten combat-action headings resolve to action:*; magic-item headings resolve to magic-item:* and same-page table captions to table:*; no entry in coverage.entries has an ambiguous status; no unique/structural owner fails page locality (compute from records.json in the test).
- Existing count assertions that this change moves (e.g. coverage.summary.ambiguous 179, diagnostics.unresolvedOwnership 73, suspiciousOwnership 55, recordNameCollisions, duplicate-group categories): per the PR #576 review, do NOT update historical aggregate counts as evidence. `summary.ambiguous` and `unresolvedOwnership` become `0` (that IS the invariant). Any other aggregate count this change moves: delete that assertion (and its history comment) and rely on the membership tests above; list each removed assertion in your completion notes.
- Negative proof: disable F2 (or one F3 family) and show the real import fails F1 naming the exact items; record output in notes; restore.

## Regenerate + verify
`npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1`, then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` (exit 0), then `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing. Expected artifact diff: source-coverage.json statuses/resolutions/diagnostics, source-region-ledger.json classifications of regions under reowned headings, possibly table:size-categories locator. records.json data must not change except that locator; any other records.json change = stop and report. Explain every changed ledger classification class in notes.

## Out of scope
Deleting the duplicate rule:* combat-action records (follow-up bead). Other diagnostic groups that are not ambiguous and pass page locality.
